cards.imageAlt: 起落架异常航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What appears to have happened to the landing gear of the aircraft in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 图中航空器的起落架似乎发生了什么？

cards.audioText: What can cause an aircraft's landing gear to collapse or retract on the ground?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器起落架在地面坍塌或收起？
cards.referenceText: A landing gear can collapse because of structural or lock failure, hard or side-loaded landing damage, overload, corrosion or maintenance error. Uncommanded retraction on the ground may involve an unsafe control action, squat-switch or sensing fault, hydraulic malfunction or failure to install required safety devices during maintenance. The actual cause requires inspection and recorded evidence rather than visual assumption alone.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起落架可能因结构或锁定机构失效、重着陆或带侧向载荷着陆造成的损伤、过载、腐蚀或维修错误而坍塌。飞机在地面意外收起起落架，可能涉及不安全的操纵动作、空地电门或传感故障、液压故障，或维修时未安装规定的安全装置。实际原因必须依据检查结果和记录证据确定，不能只凭外观推测。

cards.audioText: What consequences can result from a landing gear collapse or retraction on the ground?
cards.audioTextZh: 起落架在地面坍塌或收起可能造成哪些后果？
cards.referenceText: A collapse can damage the fuselage, wing, propeller or engine, landing gear structure, fuel tanks and nearby systems. Occupants or ground staff may be injured, and fuel leakage can create a serious fire risk. The runway or stand may be blocked while the aircraft is stabilized, evacuated, inspected and recovered.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起落架坍塌可能损坏机身、机翼、螺旋桨或发动机、起落架结构、油箱和附近系统。机上人员或地面人员可能受伤，燃油泄漏还会造成严重火灾风险。在飞机得到稳定、人员撤离、完成检查和救援搬移之前，跑道或停机位可能无法使用。
